prompt:
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Ma Chao of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the splendid Ma Chao of Xiliang, the brocade-armored warrior who once sent Cao Cao fleeing.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a glamorous, sultry allure; fair skin; round face; smaller, narrower eyes than usual anime proportion — long monolid eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; thick straight brows; upturned nose; full heart-shaped lips; ice-blue eyes; a soft rose-red tint on the lips.
Body and hair: toned athletic-curvy, full-busted with rounded hips build; two hair loops pinned high on the crown with choppy uneven bangs; antique-gold hair.
Expression: a firm, resolute look with calm, steady eyes, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: dazzling beauty and pride of the western frontier, silver armor trimmed with brocade and a lion-head belt, a white plume, vengeance for her slain family, fierce charges across the Liang steppe.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — THREE KINGDOMS
Costume: Three Kingdoms war general's armor — lamellar scale armor laced over a silk battle robe, beast-head shoulder guards, a plumed helmet or a war headband, a long war cape, her weapon at hand. Late-Han Chinese dress — cross-collared silk robes with wide sleeves and a broad sash, lamellar or scale armor laced with cords where armor is worn, bronze, jade and lacquer ornament, Han court hair ornaments; silk, lacquered leather, bronze and iron.
Silhouette: a great war cape spreading from the shoulders to the ankles as the main shape, lamellar armor beneath. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Colours: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade, with small accents of desert sand and rust orange (the Liang frontier), Taoist indigo and white (Zhang Lu).
Signature item: a silver dragon-tipped spear with a white tassel. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her robes open to show skin — the cross collar opened into a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare upper arms above detached wide sleeves (and bare shoulders where no shoulder guard sits), the skirt panels cut with a high side slit at full length — it shows the side line of one leg as she stands, no leg pushed out or knee bent for it; any armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered; keep the costume material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: Shu Han in the Sichuan basin, around 208–263 AD: the city of Chengdu, cliffside plank roads over gorges, mist-wrapped mountains and bamboo forests, peach orchards, green-and-gold banners.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers, except that a banner, seal or emblem may carry the single character 蜀 or 馬. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. Three Kingdoms-era Chinese dress, architecture and materials only.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Ma Chao from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the splendid Ma Chao of Xiliang, the brocade-armored warrior who once sent Cao Cao fleeing. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour, skin tone, costume and weapon are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

Inspiration only: dazzling beauty and pride of the western frontier, silver armor trimmed with brocade and a lion-head belt, a white plume, vengeance for her slain family, fierce charges across the Liang steppe.

World (fixed): Shu Han in the Sichuan basin, around 208–263 AD: the city of Chengdu, cliffside plank roads over gorges, mist-wrapped mountains and bamboo forests, peach orchards, green-and-gold banners. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) light armor pieces over a fitted silk martial dress, long silk sashes and a light skirt flowing from the waist and shoulders — a light, dancing silhouette; 2) layered laced lamellar armor, big heavy beast-head pauldrons and armored skirts to the knees — a broad, weighty general's silhouette; 3) fitted light lamellar armor with short armored skirts slit for riding, bracers and greaves — a lean, practical cavalry silhouette; 4) a fitted martial-arts outfit with a wide belt and arm guards, a long silk sash streaming behind — a wandering swordswoman's silhouette; 5) a great war cape spreading from the shoulders to the ankles as the main shape, lamellar armor beneath; 6) a heavy fur mantle over the shoulders with leather straps and beast ornaments — a rugged frontier silhouette; 7) a lamellar breastplate above, many layers of silk skirt flaring wide below the waist — firm above, flowing below; 8) a dark close-fitting light outfit with minimal ornament and wrapped arms and legs — a sleek silhouette, face uncovered; 9) a chest guard, a quiver, a fitted short robe and leg wraps — a light, upright archer's silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her legend, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like feathers, scales or petals, a hem or sleeve cut into a motif from her story. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a silver dragon-tipped spear with a white tassel.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): antique-gold hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): fair skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade, with small accents of desert sand and rust orange (the Liang frontier), Taoist indigo and white (Zhang Lu).

Rank (fixed): she is a famed war general — her costume must read battlefield might at first glance: imposing, richly worked armour and cloth with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour and skin tone), another costume shape from the list with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; a banner or seal may carry a single faction character, no other text; no logo or watermark.

Resolved image design — draw this interpretation within the fixed brief above:
Choose silhouette 6, a heavy fur mantle over the shoulders with leather straps and beast ornaments, a rugged frontier silhouette. Construct her mantle from stepped white fur panels backed by rigid jade-green lamellar ribs that sweep outward like wind-driven dunes, an architectural allusion to her western frontier charges; rich gold-edged brocade joins these panels as integral structural bindings. Keep the specified palette and small accent colours. Her face is a small softly rounded heart shape, clear hazel-green eyes, a small straight nose, soft coral lips and a confident serene expression. Antique-gold hair cut in a long wavy bob with an off-centre part and one slim side braid; fair skin. She stands with her torso angled slightly to the viewer's left while looking directly toward the viewer, both legs straight and balanced. One hand holds her complete silver dragon-tipped white-tasselled spear slightly diagonally beside the body, the other rests on the wide leather belt with all fingers visible. A Han frontier watch platform with distant bamboo-clad hills and pale morning mist, no animals or soldiers. Bold open neckline, bare upper arms and a high side slit; intimate areas covered. Natural five-finger hands, full figure and spear within the frame, chest-height camera.
